title: Cached derived coefficient functors, adjunction and square
statement: For a commutative condensed coefficient ring Λ and scheme morphisms, cache the existing total left derived inverse image, total right derived direct image, their existing derived adjunction, and the inverse-image square isomorphism obtained by composing through the equal composites. These are the four unchanged definitions previously in Sheaf.Paper.FiniteDiscreteDerivedCoefficientData. The same API provides a partial record of only pullback and square coherence and its concrete finite-discrete abbreviation, without the right-mate field. The coefficient interfaces share one named, proved EssentiallySmall instance for Profinite, with the same essentiallySmallSelf proof as the former anonymous local instances.

proof.text: Use the existing total derived functors and adjunction. Cache leftDerivedUpperStarComp with the named derived functors in its signature. Form coefficientAmbientSquare from the same inverse composition map, equality transport along sq.w, and other composition map, using an objectwise three-isomorphism constructor; coefficientIsoTransThree_eq identifies it with the ordinary composite. Define the generic FunctorComparisonSquare predicate as the universal component equation for functor comparisons between category families. Specialize it to the etale and internal derived functors to define CoefficientPullbackSquare; beta reduction gives exactly its former binders and equation. Reuse the same family and square interfaces in the existing records; no mathematical object or property changes. Preserve the non-exposed adjunction and ambient-square bodies and both existing equation APIs. The new coefficientAmbientSquare_eq exposes the objectwise construction to the square proof; coefficientAmbientSquare_app retains its original signature and follows from coefficientIsoTransThree_eq and NatIso.trans_app.

proof_origin.note: B3: cached composition components and a generic category-family square predicate avoid kernel expansion of concrete derived-functor components; the mathematical comparisons and square equation are unchanged. Return repair, B3 2026-10-17: rebased on the current non-exposed wrappers; retained coefficientDerivedAdjunction_eq and coefficientAmbientSquare_app and their signatures.

def coefficientAmbientSquare
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {X Y X' Y' : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y}
    {f' : X' ⟶ Y'} {g' : X' ⟶ X} (sq : CommSq g' f' f g) :
    coefficientDerivedUpperStar Λ g ⋙
        coefficientDerivedUpperStar Λ f' ≅
      coefficientDerivedUpperStar Λ f ⋙
        coefficientDerivedUpperStar Λ g'
